# Purpose

Quality checks should precede maps and rankings. Deduplication records what was removed and adds an operation to provenance.

# Workflow

```{r}
d <- rbind(example_biblio(), example_biblio()[1, ])
x <- as_biblio_project(d)
biblio_health(x)
y <- deduplicate_biblio(x)
attr(y, "dedup_log")
audit_biblio(y)
```

# Interpretation

Results should be interpreted in relation to database coverage, time window, entity normalization and analytical thresholds. Provenance should be retained whenever data are merged, deduplicated or enriched.
